classify_audio_file: classify an audio file using the AudioClassificationPipeline to predict its audio class
run_audio_classification_with_url: run audio classification on a remote audio file URL using the AudioClassificationPipeline
classify_raw_audio_numpy: classify raw numpy audio waveform data using the AudioClassificationPipeline with top_k labels
resample_and_classify_audio: resample audio to model sampling rate and classify it using the AudioClassificationPipeline
apply_sigmoid_to_classification: apply sigmoid function instead of softmax to audio classification model outputs
